Limbs of a rating

Source: R/accessors.R
rating_limbs.Rd

One row per limb: its stage range and its equation Q = C(H - a)^n. This is the part of a rating a reader needs to apply or compare it, without the fit diagnostics (see rating_diagnostics()) or the uncertainty (see rating_coefficients()).

Usage

rating_limbs(x, all_columns = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A FlodeRating or a FlodeRatingTable. A FlodeSegmentedRating is one joint model and has no independent limbs: use rating_coefficients() for its parameters.

all_columns

Logical. FALSE (default) returns the six stable columns below. TRUE returns everything the rating carries for each limb: for a fit, the diagnostics and uncertainty columns as well (rmse_cms, r_squared, n_obs, C_se and so on); for a rating that has been through flag_extrapolated_limbs(), align_limb_equations() or align_limb_boundaries(), the columns those steps add (doubtful, aligned, boundary_adjusted, the *_original values). Select the columns you want by name: the set available varies with how the rating was made and can grow between releases.

Value

A data.table with columns limb (integer, 1 is the lowest), lower_stage_m, upper_stage_m (stage, m), C, a (stage of zero flow, m) and n (exponent); with all_columns = TRUE, those first and then the rest. A copy: changing it does not change the rating.

See also

rating_coefficients(), rating_diagnostics(), as_rating_table()

Examples

set.seed(1)
stage_m <- seq(0.5, 2.5, by = 0.05)
discharge_cms <- 5 * stage_m^1.6 + rnorm(length(stage_m), sd = 0.02)
fit <- rate_optimise(discharge_cms, stage_m)
rating_limbs(fit)
#>     limb lower_stage_m upper_stage_m        C            a        n
#>    <int>         <num>         <num>    <num>        <num>    <num>
#> 1:     1           0.5           2.5 4.991305 -0.001447794 1.600899
